notes: Orange juice: IMDb quotes place 'Yeah, orange juice.' / 'Straight?' at Rachel's gated house when Frank first arrives, not a bar. The drink line names no place, so it stands. Zinc ('the atomic number of zinc is thirty') and 'Alexander Graham Bell, to see Miss Marron' are both said at the gate intercom (IMDb). AFI calls the Miami event a charity event, so 'Miami benefit' is fine. Katana and scarf confirmed on Tropedia. No Wikiquote page exists for the film.

vibe.verdict: The show-night club with the katana, the zinc pass number, Portman in Miami and the Oscar shot is true to the film, but the food is generic supper club and the stock club footer ('Two drink minimum... Cover charge after nine') sounds like any venue.
missing: Frank carries Rachel out of the riot at her concert (the poster moment, unused in the words)
Frank and Rachel's date: a movie, then a slow dance at the bar (AFI)
Frank pulls Fletcher off the boat before it explodes (Herb's cabin)
The airport goodbye: Rachel stops the plane and runs back for one last kiss
Frank's 'I'm here to keep you alive' rules running all film
ideas: Swap the stock footer 'Two drink minimum at the stage tables. Cover charge after nine.' for 'No photos. No autographs. Security walks you to the car.' so it reads as Rachel's show, not any club
Swap 'Spiced nuts for the green room' note for Devaney's real line as a nod: 'We'll go straight back to the green room.'
Swap the generic snapper's side for the bar-date slow dance on the bar list: 'Last dance at the bar' beer, after Frank and Rachel's date (AFI)
Add the riot to the sign: 'One night only. Riot exits to the left.'
